title: The nonlinear gauge generator has closed range on the triangular domain

closed_range.generator: At a triangular-domain configuration (A,phi), R_(A,phi) chi=(d chi,i e chi Qphi)
closed_range.parameter_split: H^(s+1)(T3;R)=R constants direct_sum H^(s+1)_0 mean-zero functions
closed_range.based_lower_bound: Poincare gives ||chi_0||_(H^(s+1))<=C||d chi_0||_(H^s), so the connection component alone makes the based generator bounded below
closed_range.matter_continuity: Triangular multiplication estimates make chi map to chi Qphi continuous at the declared finite tier; this term cannot destroy the derivative lower bound
closed_range.constant_part: Constants have at most one-dimensional image span{(0,i e Qphi)} and a closed kernel when Qphi=0
closed_range.closed_sum: The based image is closed and the constant image is finite dimensional; their sum is the full closed gauge-generator range
closed_range.kt_effect: The degree-minus-one nonlinear KT/gauge map has closed range at every admitted configuration, and its stabilizer is explicit
closed_range.boundary: Closed gauge range is not exactness of the full BV complex, a BFV boundary construction, quantization or positive physical Hilbert cohomology
